input.meaning: fixed source threshold: first triangular number with more than 500 positive divisors

source_notes.python: The pinned sol1 has no input and uses the strict predicate divisor_count(triangular) > 500.
source_notes.c: The pinned sol1 defaults to threshold 500 but accepts a command-line override. Its loop bound i < sqrtl(n) + 1 visits ceil(sqrt(n)); when that value divides n it counts the complementary factor pair twice. Its else-if square-root correction is unreachable because n % i == 0 already matches. This package follows Python sol1 on their shared fixed-threshold input.
